title: PixelKin - Gleam Fanfare (first constellation relit)
_note: Brief triumphant one-shot (~5s incl. ring-out; resolves home at ~3.4s) played when the player earns a Gleam (relights a constellation - the game's 'badge' moment). NOT looped: it builds and resolves HARD on the tonic, ringing out. Distinct from the existing ~1s 'world-gleam' SFX sparkle - this is the full musical payoff cue. Cohesive with the score: C major, pulse25 lead + pulse12 music-box arp + tri_bass, plus a bright bell for the Light/'true starlight' signature (a constellation is relighting). The melody is the Vesper motif made TRIUMPHANT: the hopeful rising lift (G->C->D) blooms upward and overshoots to the octave, then the settle (E->D->C) lands firmly home on a high C with a bell sparkle - 'the lantern lifted to the sky, the warmth returning'. Render with --loops 1 and a small tail for the bell ring.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Vesper motif made triumphant, tight ~3-bar one-shot. Pickup lift G3->C4->D4 then climbs E4->G4->C5 (the constellation rising), overshoots up to D5->E5, then the settle E5->D5->C5 lands hard HOME on the downbeat of bar 3, held and ringing. Ascending and conclusive.
tracks.notes: G3e C4e D4e E4e G4q C5q | D5q E5q D5q C5q | C5h.

tracks.name: harmony
tracks._note: Fast rising broken-chord arp (the chip 'chord') outlining C -> G(dom) under the rise, then a bright C-triad sparkle landing on the bar-3 home and ringing.
tracks.notes: C4s E4s G4s C5s E4s G4s C5s E5s C4s E4s G4s C5s E4s G4s C5s E5s | G3s D4s G4s B4s D5s B4s G4s D4s G3s D4s G4s B4s D5s B4s G4s D4s | C5s E5s G5s C6s C5q.

tracks.name: bass
tracks._note: Strong root motion C -> G(dom) -> C, the classic triumphant cadence, landing hard on the C downbeat of bar 3 and holding under the resolve.
tracks.notes: C2q C2q G2q G2q | G2q G2q G2q G2q | C2h.

tracks.name: bell
tracks._note: Light-signature sparkle: silent under the rise, then a ringing high C-E-G bell chime exactly on the bar-3 home resolution (the constellation catching light). Tail rings out.
